zufft: Fast Fourier, Cosine and Sine Transforms with a Bundled 'ducc0'

Source: R/zufft-package.R
zufft-package.Rd

Computes discrete Fourier transforms (complex, real-to-complex and complex-to-real) and discrete cosine and sine transforms of types one to four over any axes of an array, with the 'FFT' code of 'ducc0' (https://github.com/mreineck/ducc) bundled in the 'BSD'-licensed subset that 'SciPy' uses, so that no system 'FFTW' library is needed. Transforms of any length run in O(n log n) time, real input uses true real transforms, and several threads can share one transform. The interface follows the conventions of 'scipy.fft' and offers the unnormalised inverse of 'fftwtools' and stats::fft().
